sources.title_en: Florida woman arrested for allegedly making threats in an AI chat

sources.summary:
As reported by the Gulf Coast News network, Anthropic’s Claude AI chatbot flagged a conversation with 30-year-old Carli Michelle Heller after she allegedly made violent threats toward the Lee County Sheriff’s Office. Human reviewers then viewed the messages and reported them to police, the report says.
[Link: Bonita Springs woman accused of using AI to make violent threats against Lee County Sheriff's Office | https://www.gulfcoastnewsnow.com/article/florida-woman-arrest-ai-threat-sheriff-lee-co
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 据 Gulf Coast News network 报道，Anthropic 的 Claude 聊天机器人标记了 30 岁 Carli Michelle Heller 涉嫌对 Lee County Sheriff’s Office 发出暴力威胁的对话，人工审核员查看后报警，她因此被逮捕。
